demonstrates: optimization.DifferentialEvolution(problem).optimize(maxiter, disp, workers), the 'real_y_intercept' and 'seidel' operand types, and a 'conic' variable.
notes: workers=-1 (upstream) forks one worker per CPU. AGENTS.md forbids launching parallel solver processes on this shared machine, so this reproduction runs workers=1. That changes wall time, not the search: DifferentialEvolution's population update is identical, only the objective evaluations are serialized.
